name: identity_provider_groups
description: Owner-selected default group for each external sign-in provider; no implicit permission policy.
lifecycle: Two fixed rows seeded by migration. Owners update with recent strong authentication and optimistic version checks. Verified provider sign-in adds normal, audited membership; changing the selection does not remove existing memberships. A selected group cannot be deleted.

columns.Meaning: External sign-in provider: pdt or sankhya.
Existing normal group joined after successful provider sign-in.
columns.Null meaning: No automatic membership for this provider.

columns.Meaning: Optimistic concurrency version incremented on every selection change.
Owner who selected the group; historical identity_persons identifier without a foreign key, retained through consolidation.
columns.Null meaning: The selection has never been changed by an owner.

columns.Meaning: When the selection was last changed, or initially seeded.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((group_id IS NULL) OR (updated_by IS NOT NULL)))
constraints.Purpose: A selected group must have an attributable selecting owner.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (group_id) REFERENCES identity_groups(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An owner must clear or replace a default before deleting its group.
Only the two supported external sign-in providers.
